fonts.display: 'PP Neue Montreal', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'PP Neue Montreal', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Espresso
palette.role: Page canvas and primary surface — warm coffee-black rather than pure black, the entire site sits on this

palette.name: Midnight Cocoa
palette.role: Deepest surface for footers and recessed bands — almost-black brown for slight layering below Espresso

palette.name: Warm Cream
palette.role: Primary text and icon strokes — the only ink color across the system, reads as off-white parchment in dark contexts

palette.name: Soft Cream
palette.role: Occasional light surface tint where near-white is needed (rare, secondary to Warm Cream)

palette.name: Walnut
palette.role: Subtle hairline borders on dark surfaces — warm taupe that holds edges without competing with content

palette.name: Cedar
palette.role: Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Driftwood
palette.role: Muted helper text and secondary labels — warm gray that recedes against Espresso without disappearing

palette.name: Burnt Edge
palette.role: Faint internal border on cards and panels — barely-visible depth line on the dark canvas

palette.name: Amber Forge
palette.role: Primary action fill, accent highlights, and the system signal color — the only chromatic accent; appears on filled CTAs, icon hover states, and section dividers. Pairs against Espresso for a heated-metal contrast that feels pressed-in and intentional
